decisions.reason: Extending the reusable AI prompt to all grades does not resume or alter the deferred C# random-generator requirement.
The source expands prompt usage across grades but does not establish curriculum coverage, resolve the outstanding Grade 5 content ambiguity, or change alignment rules.
Prompt coverage across all grades does not change the required visual object distinctions or specified object types for levels.
The source concerns the efficiency and grade coverage of AI prompting, not the progression structure or curriculum-block basis of levels.
Applying a prompt across all grades does not change the three-question count or the review-before-generator sequence for each level.
The prompt's all-grade coverage does not alter how an existing question is copied into each applicable level.
